11	
12	import os
13	import shutil
14	import sys
15	from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
16	
17	
18	def baseline_root() -> str:
19	    env = (os.environ.get("BENCH_BASELINE_REWARD_ROOT") or "").strip()
20	    if env and os.path.isdir(env):
21	        return env
22	    if os.path.isdir("/hidden/baseline"):
23	        return "/hidden/baseline"
24	    return ""
25	
26	
27	def workspace_root() -> str:
28	    for cand in (
29	        (os.environ.get("BENCH_WORKSPACE") or "").strip(),
30	        "/workspace",
31	        os.getcwd(),
32	    ):
33	        if cand and os.path.isdir(os.path.join(cand, "verl")):
34	            return cand
35	    return os.getcwd()
36	
37	
38	def list_baseline_py_rels(root: str) -> List[str]:
39	    rels: List[str] = []
40	    if not root or not os.path.isdir(root):
41	        return rels
42	    for dirpath, _dirnames, filenames in os.walk(root):
43	        if "__pycache__" in dirpath.replace("\\", "/").split("/"):
44	            continue
45	        for name in filenames:
46	            if not name.endswith(".py"):
47	                continue
48	            full = os.path.join(dirpath, name)
49	            rel = os.path.relpath(full, root).replace("\\", "/")
50	            rels.append(rel)
51	    rels.sort()
52	    return rels
53	
54	
55	def _rel_to_modname(rel: str) -> str:
56	    rel = rel.replace("\\", "/").lstrip("/")
57	    if rel.endswith(".py"):
58	        rel = rel[:-3]
59	    return rel.replace("/", ".")
60	
61	
62	def _clear_pycache_for(path: str) -> None:
63	    parent = os.path.dirname(path)
64	    base = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(path))[0]
65	    pycache = os.path.join(parent, "__pycache__")
66	    if not os.path.isdir(pycache):
67	        return
68	    for name in os.listdir(pycache):
69	        if name.startswith(base + "."):
70	            try:
71	                os.remove(os.path.join(pycache, name))
72	            except OSError:
73	                pass
74	
75	
76	def purge_modules_for_rels(rels: List[str]) -> None:
77	    """Drop swapped modules from sys.modules so next import reads disk."""
78	    targets = {_rel_to_modname(r) for r in rels}
79	    # Also drop importlib-sealed helpers in reward_score
80	    try:
81	        import verl.utils.reward_score as rs
82	
83	        cache = getattr(rs, "_BASELINE_FN_CACHE", None)
84	        if isinstance(cache, dict):
85	            cache.clear()
86	    except Exception:
87	        pass
88	
89	    to_del = []
90	    for name in list(sys.modules.keys()):
91	        if name in targets:
92	            to_del.append(name)
93	            continue
94	        for t in targets:
95	            if name.startswith(t + "."):
96	                to_del.append(name)
97	                break
98	    for name in to_del:
99	        sys.modules.pop(name, None)
100	
101	
102	def install_baseline_files(
103	    *,
104	    baseline: Optional[str] = None,
105	    workspace: Optional[str] = None,
106	) -> Dict[str, Any]:
107	    """
108	    Paste all sealed *.py under baseline onto workspace. Returns state for restore.
109	    """
110	    broot = baseline if baseline is not None else baseline_root()
111	    wroot = workspace if workspace is not None else workspace_root()
112	    state: Dict[str, Any] = {
113	        "ok": False,
114	        "baseline": broot,
115	        "workspace": wroot,
116	        "rels": [],
117	        "backups": {},  # rel -> original bytes or None if missing
118	        "installed": [],
119	    }
120	    if not broot or not os.path.isdir(broot):
121	        return state
122	    if not wroot or not os.path.isdir(wroot):
123	        return state
124	
125	    rels = list_baseline_py_rels(broot)
126	    for rel in rels:
127	        src = os.path.join(broot, rel)
128	        dst = os.path.join(wroot, rel)
129	        if os.path.isfile(dst):
130	            with open(dst, "rb") as f:
131	                state["backups"][rel] = f.read()
132	        else:
133	            state["backups"][rel] = None
134	        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dst), exist_ok=True)
135	        shutil.copy2(src, dst)
136	        _clear_pycache_for(dst)
137	        state["installed"].append(rel)
138	
139	    state["rels"] = list(rels)
140	    state["ok"] = True
141	    if state["installed"]:
142	        print(
143	            f"[bench] validate: pasted {len(state['installed'])} sealed baseline "
144	            f"file(s) from {broot}",
145	            flush=True,
146	        )
147	    return state
148	
149	
150	def restore_baseline_files(state: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
151	    """Restore Agent workspace files after validate."""
152	    if not state or not state.get("ok"):
153	        return
154	    wroot = state.get("workspace") or ""
155	    backups: Dict[str, Any] = state.get("backups") or {}
156	    restored = 0
157	    for rel, blob in backups.items():
158	        dst = os.path.join(wroot, rel)
159	        if blob is None:
160	            # sealed-only file that did not exist before: remove paste
161	            try:
162	                if os.path.isfile(dst):
163	                    os.remove(dst)
164	            except OSError:
165	                pass
166	            continue
167	        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dst), exist_ok=True)
168	        with open(dst, "wb") as f:
169	            f.write(blob)
170	        _clear_pycache_for(dst)
171	        restored += 1
172	    if restored or state.get("installed"):
173	        print(
174	            f"[bench] validate: restored {restored} Agent file(s) after baseline paste",
175	            flush=True,
176	        )
177	
178	
179	def begin_baseline_validate(reward_loop_manager=None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
180	    """Paste sealed files + reinit reward workers to pick up baseline code."""
181	    state = install_baseline_files()
182	    state["reward_loop_manager"] = reward_loop_manager
183	    if not state.get("ok") or not state.get("rels"):
184	        return state
185	    purge_modules_for_rels(state["rels"])
186	    mgr = reward_loop_manager
187	    if mgr is not None and getattr(mgr, "reward_loop_workers", None):
188	        import ray
189	
190	        ray.get(
191	            [
192	                w.reinit_reward_fn.remote(state["rels"])
193	                for w in mgr.reward_loop_workers
194	            ]
195	        )
196	    return state
197	
198	
199	def end_baseline_validate(state: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
200	    """Restore Agent files + reinit reward workers."""
201	    if not state:
202	        return
203	    restore_baseline_files(state)
204	    rels = list(state.get("rels") or [])
205	    if rels:
206	        purge_modules_for_rels(rels)
207	    mgr = state.get("reward_loop_manager")
208	    if mgr is not None and getattr(mgr, "reward_loop_workers", None):
209	        import ray
210	
211	        try:
212	            ray.get([w.reinit_reward_fn.remote(rels) for w in mgr.reward_loop_workers])
213	        except Exception as e:
214	            print(f"[bench] WARN: reward worker reinit after restore failed: {e}", flush=True)

40	    if not root or not os.path.isdir(root):
41	        return rels
42	    for dirpath, _dirnames, filenames in os.walk(root):
43	        if "__pycache__" in dirpath.replace("\\", "/").split("/"):
44	            continue
45	        for name in filenames:
46	            if not name.endswith(".py"):
47	                continue
48	            full = os.path.join(dirpath, name)
49	            rel = os.path.relpath(full, root).replace("\\", "/")
50	            rels.append(rel)
51	    rels.sort()
52	    return rels

54	
55	def _rel_to_modname(rel: str) -> str:
56	    rel = rel.replace("\\", "/").lstrip("/")
57	    if rel.endswith(".py"):
58	        rel = rel[:-3]
59	    return rel.replace("/", ".")

62	def _clear_pycache_for(path: str) -> None:
63	    parent = os.path.dirname(path)
64	    base = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(path))[0]
65	    pycache = os.path.join(parent, "__pycache__")
66	    if not os.path.isdir(pycache):
67	        return
68	    for name in os.listdir(pycache):
69	        if name.startswith(base + "."):
70	            try:
71	                os.remove(os.path.join(pycache, name))
72	            except OSError:
73	                pass
74	
75	
76	def purge_modules_for_rels(rels: List[str]) -> None:
77	    """Drop swapped modules from sys.modules so next import reads disk."""
78	    targets = {_rel_to_modname(r) for r in rels}
79	    # Also drop importlib-sealed helpers in reward_score
80	    try:
81	        import verl.utils.reward_score as rs
82	
83	        cache = getattr(rs, "_BASELINE_FN_CACHE", None)
84	        if isinstance(cache, dict):
85	            cache.clear()
86	    except Exception:
87	        pass
88	
89	    to_del = []
90	    for name in list(sys.modules.keys()):
91	        if name in targets:
92	            to_del.append(name)
93	            continue
94	        for t in targets:
95	            if name.startswith(t + "."):
96	                to_del.append(name)
97	                break
98	    for name in to_del:
99	        sys.modules.pop(name, None)

102	def install_baseline_files(
103	    *,
104	    baseline: Optional[str] = None,
105	    workspace: Optional[str] = None,
106	) -> Dict[str, Any]:
107	    """
108	    Paste all sealed *.py under baseline onto workspace. Returns state for restore.
109	    """
110	    broot = baseline if baseline is not None else baseline_root()
111	    wroot = workspace if workspace is not None else workspace_root()
112	    state: Dict[str, Any] = {
113	        "ok": False,
114	        "baseline": broot,
115	        "workspace": wroot,
116	        "rels": [],
117	        "backups": {},  # rel -> original bytes or None if missing
118	        "installed": [],
119	    }
120	    if not broot or not os.path.isdir(broot):
121	        return state
122	    if not wroot or not os.path.isdir(wroot):
123	        return state
124	
125	    rels = list_baseline_py_rels(broot)
126	    for rel in rels:
127	        src = os.path.join(broot, rel)
128	        dst = os.path.join(wroot, rel)
129	        if os.path.isfile(dst):
130	            with open(dst, "rb") as f:
131	                state["backups"][rel] = f.read()
132	        else:
133	            state["backups"][rel] = None
134	        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dst), exist_ok=True)
135	        shutil.copy2(src, dst)
136	        _clear_pycache_for(dst)
137	        state["installed"].append(rel)
138	
139	    state["rels"] = list(rels)
140	    state["ok"] = True
141	    if state["installed"]:
142	        print(
143	            f"[bench] validate: pasted {len(state['installed'])} sealed baseline "
144	            f"file(s) from {broot}",
145	            flush=True,
146	        )
147	    return state
148	
149	
150	def restore_baseline_files(state: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
151	    """Restore Agent workspace files after validate."""
152	    if not state or not state.get("ok"):
153	        return
154	    wroot = state.get("workspace") or ""
155	    backups: Dict[str, Any] = state.get("backups") or {}
156	    restored = 0
157	    for rel, blob in backups.items():
158	        dst = os.path.join(wroot, rel)
159	        if blob is None:
160	            # sealed-only file that did not exist before: remove paste
161	            try:
162	                if os.path.isfile(dst):
163	                    os.remove(dst)
164	            except OSError:
165	                pass
166	            continue
167	        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dst), exist_ok=True)
168	        with open(dst, "wb") as f:
169	            f.write(blob)
170	        _clear_pycache_for(dst)
171	        restored += 1
172	    if restored or state.get("installed"):
173	        print(
174	            f"[bench] validate: restored {restored} Agent file(s) after baseline paste",
175	            flush=True,
176	        )

179	def begin_baseline_validate(reward_loop_manager=None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
180	    """Paste sealed files + reinit reward workers to pick up baseline code."""
181	    state = install_baseline_files()
182	    state["reward_loop_manager"] = reward_loop_manager
183	    if not state.get("ok") or not state.get("rels"):
184	        return state
185	    purge_modules_for_rels(state["rels"])
186	    mgr = reward_loop_manager

188	        import ray

191	            [
192	                w.reinit_reward_fn.remote(state["rels"])
193	                for w in mgr.reward_loop_workers
194	            ]
195	        )
196	    return state

199	def end_baseline_validate(state: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
200	    """Restore Agent files + reinit reward workers."""
201	    if not state:

        # 2. build actor model
        if "actor" in self.role:
            actor_config: ActorConfig = omega_conf_to_dataclass(self.config.actor)
            actor_config.model_config = model_config
            distillation_config: Optional[DistillationConfig] = (
                omega_conf_to_dataclass(self.distillation_config) if self.distillation_enabled else None
            )

            actor_training_config = TrainingWorkerConfig(
                model_type=actor_config.model_config.get("model_type", "language_model"),
                model_config=actor_config.model_config,
                engine_config=actor_config.engine,
                optimizer_config=actor_config.optim,
                checkpoint_config=actor_config.checkpoint,
            )

            assert self.config.actor.use_dynamic_bsz == self.config.rollout.log_prob_use_dynamic_bsz

            # assign engine configs
            actor_training_config.engine_config.use_dynamic_bsz = self.config.actor.use_dynamic_bsz
            actor_training_config.engine_config.infer_max_token_len_per_gpu = (
                self.config.rollout.log_prob_max_token_len_per_gpu
            )
            actor_training_config.engine_config.infer_micro_batch_size_per_gpu = (
                self.config.rollout.log_prob_micro_batch_size_per_gpu
            )
            actor_training_config.engine_config.max_token_len_per_gpu = self.config.actor.ppo_max_token_len_per_gpu
            actor_training_config.engine_config.micro_batch_size_per_gpu = (
                self.config.actor.ppo_micro_batch_size_per_gpu
            )
            actor_training_config.engine_config.use_remove_padding = model_config.get("use_remove_padding", False)

            if self.config.actor.use_dynamic_bsz:
                assert self.config.rollout.log_prob_max_token_len_per_gpu is not None
                assert self.config.actor.ppo_max_token_len_per_gpu is not None
            else:
                assert self.config.rollout.log_prob_micro_batch_size_per_gpu is not None
                assert self.config.actor.ppo_micro_batch_size_per_gpu is not None
            if self.distillation_enabled:
                self.loss_fn = partial(
                    distillation_ppo_loss, config=actor_config, distillation_config=distillation_config
                )
            else:
                self.loss_fn = partial(ppo_loss, config=actor_config)
            self.actor = self.actor_worker_cls(config=actor_training_config)
            self.actor.reset()
            self.actor.set_loss_fn(self.loss_fn)
            self.set_dispatch_collect(mesh_name="actor", **self.actor.get_dispatch_collect())

        # 3. build rollout engine
        if "rollout" in self.role:
            rollout_config: RolloutConfig = omega_conf_to_dataclass(self.config.rollout)

            # TODO: move rollout_device_mesh into ServerAdapter
            # 3.1 build rollout device mesh (sglang need only)
            infer_tp = rollout_config.tensor_model_parallel_size * rollout_config.data_parallel_size
            infer_pp = rollout_config.pipeline_model_parallel_size
            infer_world_size = infer_tp * infer_pp
            dp = self.world_size // infer_world_size
            assert self.world_size % infer_world_size == 0, (
                f"rollout world_size: {self.world_size} is not divisible by infer_world_size: {infer_world_size}"
            )
            rollout_device_mesh = init_device_mesh(
                get_device_name(), mesh_shape=(dp, infer_tp, infer_pp), mesh_dim_names=["dp", "infer_tp", "infer_pp"]
            )

            # 3.2 initialize rollout engine
            rollout_cls: type[BaseRollout] = get_rollout_class(rollout_config.name, rollout_config.mode)
            self.rollout = rollout_cls(
                config=rollout_config, model_config=model_config, device_mesh=rollout_device_mesh
            )

            # used for LoRA (base_sync_done is unused in merge-only mode but kept for Phase 2 adapter path)
            self.base_sync_done: bool = "dummy" not in self.config.rollout.load_format
            self.layered_summon = self.config.rollout.get("layered_summon", False)
            self.peft_merge: bool = model_config.lora.get("merge", False)

        # 4. build checkpoint engine
        if "actor" in self.role:
            checkpoint_engine_config = omega_conf_to_dataclass(self.config.rollout.checkpoint_engine)
            backend = checkpoint_engine_config.backend
            bucket_size = checkpoint_engine_config.update_weights_bucket_megabytes << 20
            engine_kwargs = checkpoint_engine_config.engine_kwargs.get(backend, {})
            # If custom_backend_module is set, import it so plugins can register
            # in CheckpointEngineRegistry before the backend is instantiated.
            import_external_libs(checkpoint_engine_config.custom_backend_module or None)
            self.checkpoint_engine = CheckpointEngineRegistry.new(
                backend, is_master=(torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0), bucket_size=bucket_size, **engine_kwargs
            )

        # Free cached GPU memory so colocated vLLM processes can see it via cudaMemGetInfo
        aggressive_empty_cache(force_sync=True)

    @register(dispatch_mode=Dispatch.ONE_TO_ALL, blocking=False)
    async def update_weights(self, global_steps: int = None, mode: str = "auto"):
        """Update weights from trainer to rollout.

        1. For sync training with colocated trainer and rollout, update rollout directly from model engine.
           - before update_weights: rollout should be in sleep mode.
           - after update_weights: rollout should be in wake_up mode.
        2. For async training with disaggregated trainer and rollout, send_weights only by checkpoint engine.

        LoRA handling: when model.lora.merge=True (peft_merge), LoRA is merged into
        base weights before sync. The engine returns full HF-keyed params with
        peft_config=None, so the rollout receives a standard weight update.

        Args:
            global_steps: Current global training step count, passed to rollout for logging/tracking.
            mode: Weight update strategy. Supported values:
                - ``"auto"``: Automatically resolve to the backend configured in
                  ``config.rollout.checkpoint_engine.backend`` (default).
                - ``"naive"``: Direct in-process weight sync between colocated trainer
                  and rollout. Used for synchronous training where both share the same
                  process. Rollout must be in sleep mode before this call.
                - Any other value: Delegates to
                  :meth:`checkpoint_engine.send_weights` for asynchronous weight
                  transfer via checkpoint engine, suitable for disaggregated
                  trainer/rollout deployments.
        """

        # Resolve mode: "auto" falls back to config, explicit values take precedence
        effective_mode = mode if mode != "auto" else self.config.rollout.checkpoint_engine.backend

        # 0. send_weights only for async training with disaggregated trainer and rollout
        if effective_mode != "naive":
            per_tensor_param, _ = self.actor.engine.get_per_tensor_param()
            await self.checkpoint_engine.send_weights(per_tensor_param, global_steps=global_steps)
            return

        set_expandable_segments(False)
        log_gpu_memory_usage("Before resume weights", logger=logger)

        # 1. resume rollout memory (weights were released during sleep)
        if self.config.rollout.free_cache_engine:
            await self.rollout.resume(tags=["weights"])
        log_gpu_memory_usage("After resume weights", logger=logger)

        # 2. determine if we need a base weight sync (adapter path only)
        per_tensor_param, peft_config = self.actor.engine.get_per_tensor_param(
            layered_summon=self.layered_summon, base_sync_done=True
        )

        do_lora_base_sync = False
        if not self.peft_merge and peft_config is not None:
            self.rollout.sleep_level = 1
            do_lora_base_sync = not self.base_sync_done

        # 3. sync weights: For SGLang, we need base first (when needed), then adapter/merged
        if do_lora_base_sync:
            per_tensor_param_base, peft_config = self.actor.engine.get_per_tensor_param(
                layered_summon=self.layered_summon, base_sync_done=False
            )
            await self.rollout.update_weights(
                per_tensor_param_base, peft_config=peft_config, base_sync_done=False, global_steps=global_steps
            )

        await self.rollout.update_weights(
            per_tensor_param, peft_config=peft_config, base_sync_done=True, global_steps=global_steps
        )

        log_gpu_memory_usage("After update_weights", logger=logger)

        # 3. offload model to cpu
        if self.actor.engine.is_param_offload_enabled:
            self.actor.engine.to("cpu", model=True, optimizer=False, grad=False)
        aggressive_empty_cache(force_sync=True)

        # 4. resume kv_cache
        if self.config.rollout.free_cache_engine:
            await self.rollout.resume(tags=["kv_cache"])
        log_gpu_memory_usage("After resume kv_cache", logger=logger)

        self.base_sync_done = True
        set_expandable_segments(True)

    @register(dispatch_mode=Dispatch.DP_COMPUTE, blocking=False)
    def execute_checkpoint_engine(self, method: str, *args, **kwargs):
        """Execute checkpoint engine method.

        Args:
            method (str): Checkpoint engine method name.
            *args: Variable length argument list.
            **kwargs: Arbitrary keyword arguments.

        """
        return getattr(self.checkpoint_engine, method)(*args, **kwargs)

import torch

WeightUpdate = tuple[str, torch.Tensor]


def split_buffer_updates(
    model: torch.nn.Module, weights: list[WeightUpdate]
) -> tuple[list[WeightUpdate], list[WeightUpdate], dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
    """Split incoming weight updates into parameter and buffer updates.

    Returns the parameter updates, the buffer updates, and the model's
    ``named_buffers`` map so callers can reuse it without re-iterating.
    """
    named_buffers = dict(model.named_buffers())
    param_updates, buffer_updates = [], []
    for name, tensor in weights:
        if name in named_buffers:
            buffer_updates.append((name, tensor))
        else:
            param_updates.append((name, tensor))
    return param_updates, buffer_updates, named_buffers


@torch.no_grad()
def apply_buffer_updates(
    model: torch.nn.Module,
    buffer_updates: list[WeightUpdate],
    named_buffers: dict[str, torch.Tensor] | None = None,
) -> int:
    """Copy updated buffer tensors into the target model in-place."""
    if not buffer_updates:
        return 0

    if named_buffers is None:
        named_buffers = dict(model.named_buffers())
    loaded = 0
    for name, tensor in buffer_updates:
        if name not in named_buffers:
            continue

        target = named_buffers[name]
        if target.shape != tensor.shape:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Buffer shape mismatch for {name}: expected {tuple(target.shape)}, got {tuple(tensor.shape)}"
            )

        source = tensor.to(device=target.device, dtype=target.dtype, non_blocking=False)
        target.copy_(source, non_blocking=False)
        loaded += 1

    return loaded

315	    def _build_lora_module(self, module):
316	        module.enable_input_require_grads()
317	
318	        lora_adapter_path = getattr(self.model_config, "lora_adapter_path", None)
319	        if lora_adapter_path is not None:
320	            from peft import PeftModel
321	
322	            from verl.utils.fs import copy_to_local
323	
324	            print(f"Loading pre-trained LoRA adapter to from: {lora_adapter_path}")
325	            # Copy adapter to local if needed
326	            local_adapter_path = copy_to_local(lora_adapter_path, use_shm=self.model_config.use_shm)
327	
328	            module = PeftModel.from_pretrained(module, local_adapter_path, is_trainable=True)
329	            peft_config = module.peft_config["default"]
330	            # Ensure task_type is TaskType enum, not string
331	            if isinstance(peft_config.task_type, str):
332	                peft_config.task_type = TaskType.CAUSAL_LM
333	        else:
334	            # Convert config to regular Python types before creating PEFT model
335	            lora_config = {
336	                "task_type": TaskType.CAUSAL_LM,
337	                "r": self.model_config.lora_rank,
338	                "lora_alpha": self.model_config.lora_alpha,
339	                "target_modules": convert_to_regular_types(self.model_config.target_modules),
340	                "target_parameters": convert_to_regular_types(self.model_config.target_parameters),
341	                "exclude_modules": convert_to_regular_types(self.model_config.exclude_modules),
342	                "bias": "none",
343	            }
344	            module = get_peft_model(module, LoraConfig(**lora_config))
345	
346	            # FSDP requires all params in a flat group to share dtype: cast a
347	            # fp32 adapter to the bf16 base dtype only when they actually differ.
348	            base_dtype = next((p.dtype for p in module.parameters() if not p.requires_grad), None)
349	            if base_dtype is not None:
350	                mismatched = [p for p in module.parameters() if p.requires_grad and p.dtype != base_dtype]
351	                if mismatched:
352	                    logger.info(
353	                        f"Casting {len(mismatched)} LoRA adapter params from "
354	                        f"{mismatched[0].dtype} to {base_dtype} to match base."
355	                    )
356	                    for param in mismatched:
357	                        param.data = param.data.to(base_dtype)
358	
359	        return module

361	    def _build_fsdp_module(self, module):
362	        # TODO(ziheng): need to improve
363	        from torch.distributed.fsdp import CPUOffload, MixedPrecision
364	
365	        from verl.utils.torch_dtypes import PrecisionType
366	
367	        mixed_precision_config = self.engine_config.mixed_precision
368	        if mixed_precision_config is not None:
369	            param_dtype = PrecisionType.to_dtype(mixed_precision_config.get("param_dtype", "bf16"))
370	            reduce_dtype = PrecisionType.to_dtype(mixed_precision_config.get("reduce_dtype", "fp32"))
371	            buffer_dtype = PrecisionType.to_dtype(mixed_precision_config.get("buffer_dtype", "fp32"))
372	        else:
373	            param_dtype = torch.bfloat16
374	            reduce_dtype = torch.float32
375	            buffer_dtype = torch.float32
376	
377	        mixed_precision = MixedPrecision(param_dtype=param_dtype, reduce_dtype=reduce_dtype, buffer_dtype=buffer_dtype)
378	
379	        self._autocast_dtype = param_dtype
380	        # fp16 training requires loss scaling to avoid gradient underflow. Mirror the pattern
381	        # landed in #4036 for the legacy dp_actor path. bf16 / fp32 do not need a scaler.
382	        if param_dtype == torch.float16:
383	            from torch.distributed.fsdp.sharded_grad_scaler import ShardedGradScaler
384	
385	            self.scaler = ShardedGradScaler(growth_interval=400)
386	        else:
387	            self.scaler = None
388	
389	        auto_wrap_policy = get_fsdp_wrap_policy(
390	            module=module,
391	            config=self.engine_config.wrap_policy,
392	            is_lora=self.model_config.lora_rank > 0,
393	        )
394	
395	        fsdp_mesh = self.device_mesh
396	        sharding_strategy = get_sharding_strategy(fsdp_mesh, zero3_enable=self.engine_config.reshard_after_forward)
397	
398	        # Note: We force turn off CPUOffload because it causes incorrect results when using grad accumulation
399	        if self.engine_config.strategy == "fsdp":
400	            # cpu_offload:
401	            # - actor: None
402	            # - critic: None
403	            # - ref: CPUOffload(offload_params=True)
404	
405	            # We force reference policy to use CPUOffload to save memory.
406	            # We force turn off CPUOffload for actor because it causes incorrect results when using grad accumulation
407	            cpu_offload = None
408	            if self.engine_config.forward_only:
409	                cpu_offload = CPUOffload(offload_params=True)
410	                self._is_offload_param = False
411	                self._is_offload_optimizer = False
412	
413	            module = FSDP(
414	                module,
415	                param_init_fn=init_fn,
416	                auto_wrap_policy=auto_wrap_policy,
417	                device_id=get_device_id(),
418	                sharding_strategy=sharding_strategy,
419	                mixed_precision=mixed_precision,
420	                sync_module_states=True,
421	                device_mesh=self.device_mesh,
422	                forward_prefetch=self.engine_config.forward_prefetch,
423	                use_orig_params=self.engine_config.use_orig_params,
424	                cpu_offload=cpu_offload,
425	            )
426	        elif self.engine_config.strategy == "fsdp2":
427	            # - actor: offload_policy
428	            # - critic: offload_policy
429	            # - ref: CPUOffloadPolicy(pin_memory=True)
430	            assert CPUOffloadPolicy is not None, "PyTorch version >= 2.4 is required for using fully_shard API (FSDP2)"
431	            mp_policy = MixedPrecisionPolicy(
432	                param_dtype=param_dtype, reduce_dtype=reduce_dtype, cast_forward_inputs=True
433	            )
434	            offload_policy = None
435	            if self.engine_config.offload_policy or self.engine_config.forward_only:
436	                self._is_offload_param = False
437	                self._is_offload_optimizer = False
438	                offload_policy = CPUOffloadPolicy(pin_memory=True)
439	                self._uses_fsdp2_cpu_offload_policy = True
440	
441	            fsdp_kwargs = {
442	                "mesh": fsdp_mesh,
443	                "mp_policy": mp_policy,
444	                "offload_policy": offload_policy,
445	                "reshard_after_forward": self.engine_config.reshard_after_forward,
446	            }
447	            full_state = module.state_dict()
448	            apply_fsdp2(module, fsdp_kwargs, self.engine_config)
449	            fsdp2_load_full_state_dict(module, full_state, fsdp_mesh, offload_policy)
450	        else:
451	            raise NotImplementedError(f"Unknown strategy {self.engine_config.strategy}")
452	
453	        if self.model_config.enable_activation_offload:
454	            enable_gradient_checkpointing = self.model_config.enable_gradient_checkpointing
455	            enable_activation_offloading(module, self.engine_config.strategy, enable_gradient_checkpointing)
456	
457	        if torch.distributed.get_world_size() == 1 and fsdp_version(module) == 1:
458	            FSDP.set_state_dict_type(
459	                module,
460	                state_dict_type=StateDictType.FULL_STATE_DICT,
461	                state_dict_config=FullStateDictConfig(),
462	            )
463	        elif fsdp_version(module) == 1:
464	            FSDP.set_state_dict_type(
465	                module,
466	                state_dict_type=StateDictType.SHARDED_STATE_DICT,
467	                state_dict_config=ShardedStateDictConfig(),
468	            )
469	
470	        return module

533	    def _restore_w4a4_input_scales(self, model, model_path):
534	        """Restore input_global_scale and input_amax from checkpoint for W4A4 mode."""
535	        import glob
536	
537	        from safetensors import safe_open
538	
539	        safetensor_files = glob.glob(f"{model_path}/model*.safetensors")
540	        loaded_count = 0
541	
542	        for sf_path in safetensor_files:
543	            with safe_open(sf_path, framework="pt") as f:
544	                for key in f.keys():
545	                    if "input_global_scale" in key:
546	                        module_path = key.replace(".input_global_scale", "")
547	                        amax_key = f"{module_path}.input_amax"
548	
549	                        module = model
550	                        for part in module_path.split("."):
551	                            module = module[int(part)] if part.isdigit() else getattr(module, part)
552	
553	                        scale_val = f.get_tensor(key)
554	                        val = scale_val.item() if scale_val.numel() == 1 else scale_val.max().item()
555	                        module.input_global_scale.fill_(val)
556	
557	                        amax_val = f.get_tensor(amax_key)
558	                        amax = amax_val.item() if amax_val.numel() == 1 else amax_val.max().item()
559	                        module.input_amax.fill_(amax)
560	                        loaded_count += 1
561	
562	        logger.info(f"[QAT W4A4] Restored {loaded_count} input_global_scale/input_amax from {model_path}")
563

569	        # Apply LoRA adapters if low-rank adaptation is enabled
570	        if self._is_lora:
571	            module = self._build_lora_module(module)
572	
573	        # Apply QAT before FSDP wrapping (training only)
574	        if self._qat_enabled and not self.engine_config.forward_only:
575	            module = self._apply_qat(module)
576	
577	        # Synchronize all distributed processes before proceeding
578	        torch.distributed.barrier()
579	        if self.rank == 0:
580	            print_model_size(module)
581	        log_gpu_memory_usage("After init model from HF AutoModel", logger=logger)
582	
583	        # Wrap model with FSDP for distributed training (sharding, mixed precision, etc.)
584	        log_gpu_memory_usage("Before FSDP", logger=None)
585	        module = self._build_fsdp_module(module)
586	        log_gpu_memory_usage("After FSDP", logger=None)
587	
588	        if not self.engine_config.forward_only:
589	            # Initialize optimizer with model parameters and config settings
590	            optimizer = self._build_optimizer(module)
591	            # Create learning rate scheduler with warmup and decay settings
592	            lr_scheduler = self._build_lr_scheduler(optimizer)
593	        else:
594	            optimizer = None
595	            lr_scheduler = None
596	
597	        self.module = module
598	        self.optimizer = optimizer
599	        self.lr_scheduler = lr_scheduler

638	    def forward_backward_batch(self, data: TensorDict, loss_function: Callable, forward_only=False) -> list[TensorDict]:
639	        # note that the global_batch_size should include data on all the dp
640	        tu.assign_non_tensor(data, sp_size=self.ulysses_sequence_parallel_size)
641	
642	        # compute num_tokens in global batch for loss normalization
643	        batch_num_tokens = data["loss_mask"].sum().to(get_device_id())
644	        torch.distributed.all_reduce(
645	            batch_num_tokens, op=torch.distributed.ReduceOp.SUM, group=self.get_data_parallel_group()
646	        )

689	    def optimizer_step(self):
690	        """
691	        Clip gradients, skip update if non-finite, and step optimizer.
692	
693	        Returns:
694	            grad_norm (float): Norm of gradients before clipping.
695	        """
696	        assert self.optimizer_config.clip_grad is not None
697	
698	        # getattr fallback: some subclasses (e.g. VeOmniEngine) bypass FSDPEngine.__init__.
699	        scaler = getattr(self, "scaler", None)
700	
701	        # Unscale gradients before clip so the clip threshold is applied to true gradient
702	        # magnitudes, not scaled ones. scaler.step() will skip the update if any grad is inf/nan.
703	        if scaler is not None:
704	            scaler.unscale_(self.optimizer)
705	
706	        if isinstance(self.module, FSDP):
707	            grad_norm = self.module.clip_grad_norm_(self.optimizer_config.clip_grad)
708	        elif isinstance(self.module, FSDPModule):
709	            grad_norm = fsdp2_clip_grad_norm_(self.module.parameters(), max_norm=self.optimizer_config.clip_grad)
710	        else:
711	            grad_norm = torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(
712	                self.module.parameters(), max_norm=self.optimizer_config.clip_grad
713	            )
714	
715	        if isinstance(grad_norm, DTensor):
716	            grad_norm = grad_norm.full_tensor()
717	
718	        if scaler is not None:
719	            # scaler handles inf/nan skipping internally via _check_inf_per_device.
720	            scaler.step(self.optimizer)
721	            scaler.update()
722	        else:
723	            # if grad_norm is not finite, skip the update
724	            if not torch.isfinite(grad_norm):
725	                print(f"WARN: grad_norm is not finite: {grad_norm}")
726	                self.optimizer.zero_grad()
727	            else:
728	                self.optimizer.step()
729	
730	        if self._qat_enabled:
731	            from verl.utils.qat.core import invalidate_all_scales
732	
733	            invalidate_all_scales(self.module)
734	
735	        return grad_norm.item()

908	    def _merged_lora_per_tensor_param(self):
909	        """Stream merged (base + LoRA) weights for rollout weight sync.
910	
911	        ``state_dict()`` returns tensors that alias the live FSDP parameter
912	        storage, and ``merged_lora_context`` restores the un-merged base
913	        weights when it exits. The context therefore must stay open until the
914	        consumer has materialized every tensor: ``DTensor.full_tensor()``
915	        produces a copy, so yielded tensors remain valid after the restore.
916	        Consuming a state_dict captured inside the context after the context
917	        has exited would silently send base weights without the adapters.
918	        """
919	        device = get_device_id()
920	        try:
921	            with merged_lora_context(self.module, backup_adapters=True):
922	                params = normalize_peft_param_name(self.module.state_dict())
923	                params = convert_weight_keys(params, getattr(self.module, "_fsdp_wrapped_module", self.module))
924	                for name, param in params.items():
925	                    yield (
926	                        name,
927	                        param.to(device, non_blocking=True).full_tensor().to(torch.bfloat16, non_blocking=True)
928	                        if isinstance(param, DTensor)
929	                        # clone: plain tensors also alias module storage, and bucketed
930	                        # senders may flush after the restore has already run
931	                        else param.detach().clone(),
932	                    )
933	        finally:
934	            log_gpu_memory_usage("Before offload_fsdp_model_to_cpu", logger=logger)
935	            if self._is_offload_param:
936	                offload_fsdp_model_to_cpu(self.module)
937	            log_gpu_memory_usage("After offload_fsdp_model_to_cpu", logger=logger)

padding columns per sequence and pack the valid tokens to (total_nnz,).\n                    cu_seqlens = input_ids.offsets()\n                    seq_lengths = cu_seqlens.diff()\n                    arange = torch.arange(output.log_probs.shape[1], device=output.log_probs.device)\n                    mask = arange < seq_lengths.unsqueeze(1)\n\n                    log_probs = None\n                    if not distillation_only:\n                        log_probs = output.log_probs[mask]\n                        log_probs = torch.nested.nested_tensor_from_jagged(log_probs, cu_seqlens)\n\n                    if calculate_entropy:\n                        entropy = output.entropy[mask]\n                        entropy = torch.nested.nested_tensor_from_jagged(entropy, cu_seqlens)\n                else:\n                    raise NotImplementedError(f\"pad_mode {pad_mode} not implemented\")\n\n            else:\n                logits = output.logits  # (bsz, response_length, vocab_size)\n                temperature = output_args[\"temperature\"]  # (bsz,)\n                temperature = temperature.unsqueeze(-1).unsqueeze(-1)\n                # With TP, logits are DTensors sharded on vocab dim; gather for log_softmax.\n                if isinstance(logits, DTensor):\n                    logits = logits.full_tensor()\n                logits = logits / temperature.clamp(min=1e-8).to(logits.dtype)\n\n                if calculate_entropy:\n                    if not self.engine_config.entropy_checkpointing:\n                        entropy = verl_F.entropy_from_logits(logits)\n                    else:\n                        entropy = torch.utils.checkpoint.checkpoint(verl_F.entropy_from_logits, logits)\n\n                if calculate_sum_pi_squared:\n                    sum_pi_squared = verl_F.calculate_sum_pi_squared_from_logits(logits)\n\n                if pad_mode == DatasetPadMode.NO_PADDING:\n                    cu_seqlens = input_ids.offsets()\n                    seq_lengths = cu_seqlens.diff()\n                    starts = torch.zeros_like(seq_lengths, dtype=torch.int64)\n                    logits = torch.nested.narrow(logits, 1, starts, seq_lengths, layout=torch.jagged)\n                    logits_rmpad = torch.cat([t for t in logits.unbind()])\n                    input_ids_rmpad_rolled = output_args[\"input_ids_rmpad_rolled\"]\n\n                    # Mirror the use_remove_padding=True branch (see verl#6293).\n                    # No Ulysses SP gather here: this branch is the no-SP path\n                    # (log_probs is also not gathered) and pad_size is only\n                    # populated in output_args along the use_remove_padding=True\n                    # path of prepare_model_inputs.\n                    if distillation_use_topk:\n                        outputs = logits_processor_func(student_logits=logits_rmpad.unsqueeze(0), data=micro_batch)\n                        for k, v in outputs.items():\n                            v = v.squeeze(0)\n                            assert v.shape == (logits_rmpad.shape[0],), (\n                                f\"logits_rmpad len: {logits_rmpad.shape[0]}, {k} shape: {v.shape}\"\n                            )\n                            model_output[k] = torch.nested.nested_tensor_from_jagged(v, cu_seqlens)\n\n                    log_probs = None\n                    if not distillation_only:\n                        log_probs = logprobs_from_logits(logits=logits_rmpad, labels=input_ids_rmpad_rolled)\n\n                    # (bsz, j1), for each sample, length of each sample: [real_prompt_length + real_response_length]\n                    if not distillation_only:\n                        log_probs = torch.nested.nested_tensor_from_jagged(log_probs, cu_seqlens)\n                    if calculate_entropy:\n                        entropy = torch.nested.narrow(entropy, 1, starts, seq_lengths, layout=torch.jagged)\n                        entropy_rmpad = torch.cat([t for t in entropy.unbind()])\n                        entropy = torch.nested.nested_tensor_from_jagged(entropy_rmpad, cu_seqlens)\n                    if calculate_sum_pi_squared:\n                        sum_pi_squared = torch.nested.narrow(\n                            sum_pi_squared, 1, starts, seq_lengths, layout=torch.jagged\n                        )\n                        sum_pi_squared_rmpad = torch.cat([t for t in sum_pi_squared.unbind()])\n                        sum_pi_squared = torch.nested.nested_tensor_from_jagged(sum_pi_squared_rmpad, cu_seqlens)\n                else:\n                    raise NotImplementedError(f\"pad_mode {pad_mode} not implemented\")\n\n        if not distillation_only:\n            model_output[\"log_probs\"] = log_probs\n        if calculate_entropy:\n            model_output[\"entropy\"] = entropy\n        if calculate_sum_pi_squared:\n            model_output[\"sum_pi_squared\"] = sum_pi_squared\n\n        return model_output\n\n    def forward_step(self, micro_batch: TensorDict, loss_function, forward_only):\n        device_name = get_device_name()\n        # actually, we should avoid assigning like this...\n        micro_batch = micro_batch.to(get_device_id())\n        model_inputs, output_args = self.prepare_model_inputs(micro_batch=micro_batch)\n\n        # Honor mixed_precision.param_dtype resolved during FSDP setup. When dtype is fp32,\n        # autocast is a no-op at best and a footgun at worst, so skip it entirely.\n        # getattr fallback: some subclasses (e.g. VeOmniEngine) bypass FSDPEngine.__init__\n        # and _build_fsdp_module, so self._autocast_dtype may not be set.\n        autocast_dtype = getattr(self, \"_autocast_dtype\", torch.bfloat16)\n        autocast_ctx: ContextManager = (\n            nullcontext()\n            if autocast_dtype == torch.float32\n            else torch.autocast(device_type=device_name, dtype=autocast_dtype)\n        )\n        with autocast_ctx:\n            raw_output = self.module(\n                **model_inputs,\n                use_cache=False,\n            )  # prevent model thinks we are generating\n\n            model_output = self.prepare_model_outputs(\n                output=raw_output, output_args=output_args, micro_batch=micro_batch, logits_processor_func=loss_function\n            )\n\n            if loss_function is not None:\n                loss, metrics = loss_function(\n                    model_output=model_output, data=micro_batch, dp_group=self.get_data_parallel_group()\n                )\n            else:\n                assert forward_only, \"forward_only must be True when loss_function is None\"\n                loss = torch.tensor(1.0, device=device_name)\n                metrics = {}\n\n            # Detach model outputs before they are appended to forward_backward_batch's\n            # output_lst: they are only consumed for metrics/postprocessing after backward,\n            # and keeping their grad_fn alive retains part of every micro-batch's autograd\n            # graph until the whole batch finishes. With PEFT (enable_input_require_grads)\n            # this pins the checkpointed embedding output plus its gradient buffer per\n            # micro-batch (~2 x [total_nnz, hidden] for long sequences), which accumulates\n            # across micro-batches and OOMs the actor update.\n            model_output = {\n                key: value.detach() if torch.is_tensor(value) and value.grad_fn is not None else value\n                for key, value in model_output.items()\n            }\n            output = {\n                \"model_output\": model_output,\n                \"loss\": loss.detach().item(),\n                \"metrics\": metrics,\n            }\n\n            return loss, output\n\n\n@EngineRegistry.register(model_type=\"value_model\", backend=[\"fsdp\", \"fsdp2\"], device=[\"cuda\", \"npu\"])\nclass FSDPEngineWithValueHead(FSDPEngineWithLMHead):\n    \"\"\"\n    The only difference between critic and actor is how the raw model output is processed\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def prepare_model_outputs(self, output, output_args, micro_batch: TensorDict, logits_processor_func):\n        use_remove_padding = tu.get_non_tensor_data(data=micro_batch, key=\"use_remove_padding\", default=True)\n        pad_mode = tu.get_non_tensor_data(data=micro_batch, key=\"pad_mode\", default=DatasetPadMode.NO_PADDING)\n\n        input_ids = micro_batch[\"input_ids\"]\n        if use_remove_padding:\n            if hasattr(self.module, \"v_head\"):\n                # For trl.AutoModelForCausalLMWithValueHead\n                values_rmpad = output[2].squeeze(0)\n            else:\n                values_rmpad = output.logits\n                values_rmpad = values_rmpad.squeeze(0)  # (total_nnz, 1)\n                # critic model arch is like Qwen3ForTokenClassfication and num_labels=1\n                # so we squeeze the last dimension here to get the value for each token\n                values_rmpad = values_rmpad.squeeze(-1)\n\n            # gather output if sp > 1\n            if self.use_ulysses_sp:\n                pad_size = output_args[\"pad_size\"]\n                values_rmpad = gather_outputs_and_unpad(values_rmpad, gather_dim=0, unpad_dim=0, padding_size=pad_size)\n\n            if pad_mode == DatasetPadMode.NO_PADDING:\n                cu_seqlens = input_ids.offsets()\n                # (bsz, j1), for each sample, is the length of each sample: [real_prompt length + real_response length]\n                values = torch.nested.nested_tensor_from_jagged(values_rmpad, cu_seqlens)\n            else:\n                raise NotImplementedError(f\"pad_mode {pad_mode} not implemented\")\n\n        else:\n            if hasattr(self.module, \"v_head\"):\n                # For trl.AutoModelForCausalLMWithValueHead\n                values = output[2]\n            else:\n                values = output.logits.squeeze(-1)\n\n            if pad_mode == DatasetPadMode.NO_PADDING:\n                cu_seqlens = input_ids.offsets()\n                seq_lengths = cu_seqlens.diff()\n                starts = torch.zeros_like(seq_lengths, dtype=torch.int64)\n                values = torch.nested.narrow(values, 1, starts, seq_lengths, layout=torch.jagged)\n                values_rmpad = torch.cat([t for t in values.unbind()])\n                # (bsz, j1), for each sample, length of each sample: [real_prompt_length + real_response_length]\n                values = torch.nested.nested_tensor_from_jagged(values_rmpad, cu_seqlens)\n            else:\n                raise NotImplementedError(f\"pad_mode {pad_mode} not implemented\")\n\n        return {\"values\": values}\n", "numLines": 1468, "startLine": 1, "totalLines": 1468}}
